# Silver Bloom finish card

Silver Bloom is the proper name of decorative swatch S8. It describes a deliberately flecked exhibition surface, not the defect category used on clear production surfaces.

## Sample treatment
Mount the sample above the lettering strip. Print Silver Bloom in the left caption and retain the swatch serial on the back. A finish name cannot override the [surface inspection rubric](../bench/surface-rubric.md).
